### Lines 221-229 / 第 221-229 行
```python
def remove_subclassed_by(app, doctree, docname):
    from docutils import nodes

    for node in doctree.traverse(nodes.paragraph):
        text = node.astext()
        if text.startswith("Subclassed by "):
            # Keep if it contains actual reference links
            if not node.traverse(nodes.reference):
                node.parent.remove(node)
```
- EN: This segment defines function `remove_subclassed_by(app, doctree, docname)` and packages a reusable step in the documentation workflow. Notable calls include `doctree.traverse`, `node.astext`, `text.startswith`, `node.traverse`, `node.parent.remove`, which hint at the services this function relies on.
